title: A lesson showing the trainer’s hands
description: Short exercises show the person and the dog together, with a replay of the movements that matter.

blocks.text: In a clip with a close-up of the dog it is easy to miss the action that produced the desired response. A beginner does not understand what to repeat.

quote.text: Most of the example videos don't show the handler w dog which would be most helpful

blocks.text: Add a close angle on the hands to the wide shot, break the exercise into steps and leave a quick replay of a fragment. Show the preparation and the return to the start.
The content of the lessons takes a trainer’s work. The video has to explain the actions, not promise the same result for every dog.
